extraction_notes: Main-text performance figures digitised: Figure 7b and Figure 8a–c. Figure 7a was skipped because it is an Arrhenius plot. Figures 1–6 are characterisation and were skipped. For Figure 8, the caption includes “673 K” although temperature is the x-axis; the plotted °C x-axis values were used as the record temperatures. Blue Ba-promoted series in Figures 8b and 8c visibly show only 360, 380 and 400 °C points; no 320 or 340 °C Ba points were recorded for those panels.
